scope: Probe-backed Search/autocomplete media ownership, Search Related Searches textref cards, Cart Apex claimed coupon state, and Cart unified-promotion badge palette. Universal dual-probe architecture and launch behavior are preserved.
intentional_visual_changes: Search autocomplete suggestion image layers no longer become opaque black; exact suggestion product thumbnails remain visible and use existing autocomplete TWB opacity.
Rufus/Alexa autocomplete icon artwork is preserved rather than replaced.
Related Searches textref cards: OLED black floor, #494d4d border, white copy/search icon.
Cart claimed Apex coupon: true-green tile, white copy, OLED-black SVG circle, white check.
Cart unified-promotion badge: #5a9e43 background with OLED-black copy.
probe_architecture: Screenshot -> AmazonDark-v7.363-ui-full-probe: every current on-screen WKWebView, entire mounted DOM, full mounted native hierarchy.
scripts/ui-probe.sh arm -> one-shot SIGUSR2 -> AmazonDark-v7.363-ui-viewport-probe: only current screen-intersecting Web/native elements, no scrolling.
performance_note: No MutationObserver, timer, RAF, web-scroll listener, recurring DOM scan, or recurring native hierarchy scan was added.
validation_notes: All shipped Python regression scripts pass when executed directly.

A local Chromium renderer harness reproduces the v7.362 failures and verifies the v7.363 computed-paint corrections for Search autocomplete, Related Searches, claimed Cart coupon, and promotion badges.
Local Linux environment does not include Theos/iOS SDK; GitHub Actions remains the authoritative rootless package compile/link check.
